success_contract.objective: Create /app/solution.txt containing the full sequence of moves input by the player in the referenced Zork video, one move per line, derived from the video/transcript rather than guessed.
required_behaviors: Obtain or derive the complete move list from the referenced video
Write each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt
Preserve the original move text as entered (e.g. 'n', 'get bag')
known_invalid_patterns: Guessing the move list without evidence from the video/transcript
Providing only a summary instead of the full move list
Writing moves in any format other than one per line
Treating file existence alone as sufficient evidence
verification_plan: Locate receipt-backed transcript/video-derived text for the referenced YouTube video
Extract the player-entered commands in order
Verify the file contents against the extracted sequence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence identifying the source transcript/video-derived text
Receipt-backed evidence showing the extracted ordered move list
Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt was written with that exact ordered move list

items: Search receipts for any cached transcript or prior extraction of the Zork video
If found, extract the move list from that evidence
If not found, inspect workspace/cache for helper artifacts before attempting any new derivation
Write /app/solution.txt only after the move list is evidence-backed
Collect receipts that directly support the final artifact contents
